jobs.title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst
jobs.salary: $100,000–$119,580 base + equity; NYC location-specific offer within published range
jobs.why: Closest new traditional BA match to Audrey's Orion work: lead Salesforce stakeholder discovery, document user stories and acceptance criteria, map processes, coordinate UAT and defect resolution, maintain sprint backlog, publish release notes, and support users. Audrey did requirements, Salesforce automation, UAT, training and Agile coordination for 200+ users.
jobs.gap: Requires 3+ years in a BSA/RevOps/Salesforce-adjacent B2B SaaS setting and hands-on Jira sprint administration; Audrey has 2+ formal BA years, broader ops experience, Asana rather than Jira, and no proven B2B SaaS employment. CPQ/NUE, NetSuite and Boomi are additional gaps.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.why: Fresh October 20 opening with strong transfer from Orion: improve Salesforce flows and reporting, data governance, contract workflows, process troubleshooting, cross-functional requirements, testing and documentation. Audrey's automated legal agreement processes, data audits and finance QA are particularly relevant.
jobs.gap: Role asks for 3–4+ years of GTM/Revenue/Business Systems experience and stronger quote-to-cash, CPQ, subscription billing, usage-based monetization, revenue forecasting and SaaS exposure. SQL is a plus rather than a core required skill.

jobs.title: Revenue Operations Analyst
jobs.location: Remote — United States (Walnut Creek CA hybrid preferred, not required)
jobs.salary: $80,000–$98,000 base + 10–12% variable; $88,000–$110,000 OTE. $100K only possible with variable pay; not guaranteed.
jobs.why: Exceptionally strong hands-on Salesforce alignment: configure formula fields, validation rules, Flows, permissions, page layouts and dashboards; audit duplicate records and data integrity; automate repetitive GTM tasks. Audrey did these activities at Orion and has advanced Excel and process documentation experience. Role asks 1–4 years related operations/analytics.
jobs.gap: Base salary never reaches $100K; variable pay needed. Audrey has no demonstrated sales territory/quota planning, SaaS GTM forecasting, Sweep.io or Hex, and independent SQL is not yet established.
